title: Grand Mosque of Paris
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Grand Mosque of Paris complex:cream square minaret with broad recessed diamond-lattice abstraction,green frieze/crenellations,smaller lantern/pyramidal top/three-orb finial;green roof edges,white horseshoe entry portal,open garden with broad planted beds/basin and white horseshoe patio arcades/central bowl. Mapped prayer hall/roof dome and ancillary ranges retain their component plans/envelopes. Six shared256² graphs,eight merged groups,four authored browser levels. Pictures guide signature forms;fine carving/calligraphy,exact planting/ornament and2016 temporary transparent courtyard cover are omitted. Untagged subdivisions,unpictured roofs/baths,current finish and precise terrain/threshold contacts remain approximate or unverified.
